study.topic: Best-Performing Construction Calculators & Realistic iOS/Android Emulators
study.goal: Identify exact UI/UX, keypad, and visual diagram mechanics of top-grossing carpentry calculators and realistic iPhone/Android emulators for CutCoach AI

coverage.question: calc-benchmarks.q1
coverage.text: What exact UI layouts, tactile keypad mechanics, 2D/3D visualizers, and workflows make the top-performing construction calculators succeed on site?
coverage.criterion: At least 2 independent primary/high sources detailing feature sets, UI layouts, and user ratings of leading carpentry calculators
coverage.rationale: Three independent primary vendor sources establish the exact keypad, 3D/2D blueprint, cut-list, and offline unit-switching patterns of top construction calculators.

coverage.question: mobile-emulators.q1
coverage.text: What are the most realistic iPhone and Android emulators and photorealistic device frame systems that can run our calculator app on Vercel and desktop?
coverage.criterion: At least 2 independent primary/high sources covering cloud OS emulators (Appetize, Expo Snack) and photorealistic web device frames (Devices.css, Apple/Google bezels)
coverage.rationale: Two independent sources confirm the exact architecture of realistic iOS Simulator and Android Emulator web embeds and device preview shells.

status.jev_gate_note: Reference presence only; review linked trial/evaluated-use/reuse/skip. No claim of provider use, valid assessment or savings.
